help.background: Run the process in the background. Use this option when there are computation time errors or when the tool doesn't show promptly results.
help.rsa: Use Real Surface Area. Disable it to calculate the results using planimetric area. To more details, please refer to the module documentation.
help.scale: "Native" uses the resolution of the land cover data. A coarser scale makes the process faster, but less accurate. The maximum is 1500 m, because the mountain belts are not accurate at coarser scales.

desc.belt_1: Mountain areas where the growing season mean temperature is below < 3.5 °C and the growing season length is less than 10 days
desc.belt_2: Mountain areas where the growing season mean temperature is between 3.5 °C and 6.4 °C and the growing season length is between 10 and 54 days.
desc.belt_3: Mountain areas where the growing season mean temperature is between 6.4 °C and 15 °C’
desc.belt_4: Mountain areas where the growing season mean temperature is above 15 °C’

label.background: Run in EE background (for large datasets)

tasks.description:
This section is designed to help you with calculations that are running in the background on Google Earth Engine. Here is what you can do:

- **Locate Your Task File**: A unique 'task file' is created for each calculation that was sent to the GEE background, which you can find at '{folder}' folder.
- **Monitor Your Task**: Keep an eye on your task's progress and check its current status at any time.
- **Download Results**: Once completed, you can download the results and reporting tables directly from here.
- **View Your Dashboard**: Your results will automatically populate the dashboard, making it easy to review and analyze the data.
Just follow the steps provided on this page to smoothly manage and retrieve your calculation outputs.

target.description: This module allows users to modify the default target land cover classes used in the reclassification process. The module is set to use the standard 10 SEEA classes by default, but for sub indicator B, users have the option to either use these default classes or create their own custom classification. To use the custom classification option, simply select the 'custom' button and upload a file containing the target classifications that will be used in the reclassification table.

veg_layer.description:
SDG indicator 15.4.2 makes use land cover data to evaluate and monitor land cover change and its estimated impact in terms of ecosystem degradation and recovery.
Please indicate below if you wish to use a set of custom land cover maps of your country to compute both indicators. If not, the tool will use the land cover time series produced by the European Space Agency (ESA) under the Climate Change Initiative (CCI) as a default global solution (For further information on this dataset, please check http://maps.elie.ucl.ac.be/CCI/viewer/index.php)
